$description: Wave 4 (W4 Web Overlays, D-018) component tokens for Toast. Reused by Snackbar (Reuse Check, D-018: Snackbar is implemented as a lighter-weight consumer of the same ToastProvider/token set — see Toast.tsx module doc for the full reuse-vs-separate-component decision). bg/border/text mirror Popover/Dialog's surface-ladder panel treatment exactly (one visual language for every floating layer in the system) with `shadow.elevation.md` (braun-flat rule 2 explicitly permits toast; md matches Popover's weight since a toast floats at a similar height to a popover, less than a full-screen-blocking Dialog). variant.* provides the non-decorative accent-bar + icon color for each semantic variant (default/success/warning/danger) using the ALREADY-locked `color.feedback.*` tokens (D-006) — reused directly, no new hue introduced. Contrast self-check against `color.surface.overlay` (the bg every toast renders on): text.default = 14.85:1 (light) / 11.11:1 (dark); feedback.success 4.62:1 (light) / 5.20:1 (dark); feedback.warning 7.12:1 (light) / 5.01:1 (dark); feedback.danger 5.03:1 (light) / 4.88:1 (dark); feedback.info (used for 'default' variant's neutral accent — actually default variant uses text.subtle, not feedback.info, see below) — every feedback.* pairing clears 4.5:1 in both themes, so these are safe to use for the small icon glyph AND the thin accent-bar (a non-text UI element that only needs 3:1, so passing 4.5:1 is a comfortable margin). default variant's accent reuses `color.border.interactive` (2.99:1 dark / 4.20:1 light against surface.overlay — passes the 3:1 UI-boundary minimum in both themes, this is a non-text decorative bar not body text) rather than inventing a fifth hue for the 'no particular feedback' case.
